fichas.title: Trucks—Parking and Turning
fichas.summary: Illustrated layouts show parking arrangements and turning requirements for trucks, buses, articulated vehicles, and delivery trucks. The text notes that truck dimensions vary considerably, so permanent lanes or bays are not worthwhile; maneuvering space depends on vehicle dimensions and movement, with the swept path of trailing inner rear wheels particularly important when cornering. Turning-circle guidance gives an outer radius of 12 m for the largest regulated vehicles and 10 m as sufficient for most trucks within the regulations.
uses: Parking trucks, buses, and articulated vehicles
Maneuvering and turning in restricted spaces
